mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 53 degrees and the moon is currently in its third quarter.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz is honoring the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to our city. Also, remember to check your mail for notifications regarding upcoming cross connection control surveys for your water utility.
You have plenty to look forward to! Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, visit the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow, or check out the World Dairy Expo this Saturday.

In a report covering September 14 to September 28, officers noted that on September 24, an 11-year-old child was involved in a bicycle crash at Westward Drive and Jenna Drive after failing to stop at a stop sign.
If you are looking for a sweet treat, today's flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM.
